name: Monuments of Oviedo and the Kingdom of the Asturias
description: In and around Oviedo, in northern Spain, stand a group of small stone churches and buildings from the 9th century, when Asturias was a tiny Christian kingdom. Its builders developed a distinctive pre-Romanesque style, seen at Santa María del Naranco, San Miguel de Lillo, Santa Cristina de Lena and the Cámara Santa. The group also includes La Foncalada, a rare early public water structure.
